standard_positions.standard: Confidentiality obligations last 3 years from disclosure.
standard_positions.known_redline: If term exceeds 5 years or is perpetual, request reduction to 3 years.

standard_positions.standard: Governed by the laws of England and Wales.
standard_positions.known_redline: If foreign governing law, flag for legal — we prefer England and Wales.

standard_positions.standard: Confidential information used solely for the stated business purpose.
standard_positions.known_redline: If purpose is broad or undefined, request it be narrowed.

order_form.description: Customer order form / small commercial order

standard_positions.standard: Liability capped at fees paid in the prior 12 months.
standard_positions.acceptable_range: 12 months' fees; up to 24 months acceptable
standard_positions.known_redline: If uncapped or a large multiple of fees, escalate to legal.

standard_positions.standard: Payment due within 30 days of invoice.
12-month term, renewing annually unless cancelled with 30 days notice.
standard_positions.acceptable_range: 12 months; auto-renew acceptable with notice window
standard_positions.known_redline: If auto-renew has no notice window, request one.

standard_positions.standard: Each party retains its own pre-existing IP.
standard_positions.known_redline: If customer claims ownership of our IP, escalate to legal.
